patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Closely's shape. Choose Closely only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label ” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Closely leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Closely share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Closely is LinkedIn + email outbound automation platform with enrichment, AI agents, and white-label options for agencies..
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Closely-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Closely — Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record..

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Closely: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.; Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles..
